proofPoints.purpose: Measure verified useful activity without turning every action into an immediately tradable reward.

contributionReceipts.purpose: Record the category, actor, reference digest, season, reviewer state and anti-Sybil outcome of a contribution.

tproof.purpose: Coordinate standards governance, public-goods funding, proposal bonds, challenge bonds and sponsored contribution pools.

allocations.purpose: Seasonal rewards for verified product use, network expansion and public-goods contribution.
Open-source integrations, developer grants, infrastructure and ecosystem public goods.
Long-term core protocol and product stewardship.
Milestone-based incentives for real organizations, connectors and repeat trade usage.
Potential post-launch liquidity subject to legal review, governance approval and transparent lock terms.
Security bounties, independent audits, standards research and emergency public-goods work.

genesisSeason.name: Season 0: Genesis Proof
genesisSeason.eligibilityPrinciple: Reward verified early utility, integrations, security work and genuine cross-wallet trade-response loops; never reward page views or wallet connection alone.

conditions: issuer wallet is the transaction sender
Passport remains current through the review delay
responder wallet differs from Passport issuer
wallet pair has not exceeded its seasonal cap
roles are self-declared until organizational attestations exist
responses reference the same current Passport lineage
a prior responder wallet later anchors its own distinct Passport
the new Passport digest is not a duplicate
wallet participates in a second distinct Passport lineage
the second lineage has at least one independent external response
the event occurs in the same or following season

requirements: public evidence or independently reviewable evidence
named reviewer decision or governed review process

principles: No reward for wallet creation, wallet connection, page views or raw social impressions.
Self-responses and duplicate artifacts earn zero points.
Repeated activity between the same wallet pair is capped.
Claims settle only after a review delay.
Suspicious funding, timing and transaction-graph clusters may be excluded.
High-value public-goods rewards require human or governed review.
Contribution receipts may be revoked for proven spam, duplication or deception.

tokenUtility.description: Vote on supported schemas, canonicalization profiles and protocol standards; governance cannot declare a real-world trade fact true.
Direct ecosystem, integration, security and standards funding.
Refundable bond for formal standards or treasury proposals; forfeitable only under published spam rules.
Bond for challenging a contribution allocation or receipt; returned when the challenge is upheld.
Organizations or community members may lock tokens into transparent pools that reward predefined integrations or adoption outcomes.
Token holders may signal or allocate matching budgets toward open-source ecosystem work.

permanentBoundaries: Holding or staking TPROOF never makes a Passport, Response, evidence record or real-world assertion valid.
Basic Passport creation, local verification and public Registry reading do not require TPROOF.
TPROOF provides no ownership of trade goods, receivables, invoices, payments or other real-world assets.
TPROOF provides no revenue share, dividend, guaranteed yield, redemption promise or guaranteed price support.
No private source document is required to be stored onchain.
Governance cannot rewrite historical Registry records or silently change fixed-supply allocation.
launchGates: TradeProofContribution contract implemented and independently reviewed
TradeProofToken and vesting contracts implemented with fixed supply and no hidden mint path
all contracts deployed and source-verified on testnet
public token economics and crypto-asset disclosure published from one canonical source
target-jurisdiction legal review completed before any public offer or admission to trading
Genesis anti-Sybil, review and appeal rules published
treasury multisig, signer policy and timelock published
community approval of final launch parameters
no public sale, liquidity action or claim activation before all gates pass
